subject: ForgeSys customer story & logo use — confidentiality + embargo
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@forgesys.com>, Sam Patel <sam@forgesys.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-11T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: ForgeSys customer story & logo use — confidentiality + embargo

Hi Elena / Sam,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — the pilot data looks very promising. As we discussed, we'd love to turn the pilot into a short customer story (one-page case study + press announcement) and to include the ForgeSys logo on our customer page. To move forward we need to align a couple of legal points so our marketing and legal teams can finalize collateral and timing.

Quick summary of what Redwood is proposing (attached: MSA excerpt + draft press guidelines):
- Public press release and one-page case study once ForgeSys signs the final Order Form.
- Logo use: Redwood may display the ForgeSys logo on marketing pages and in press materials, subject to pre-publication approval (30-day review window).
- Quotes: we will include a short customer quote; we can anonymize or attribute to a named contact per your preference.
- Embargo: Redwood proposes announcement after GA (or 30 days after go-live), but willing to accept a different window if needed.
- Confidentiality carveouts: any confidential data in the case study will be redacted; we will not disclose product configuration or PII.

Can you please confirm the following or provide redlines: preferred embargo window, whether ForgeSys requires anonymized quotes, any logo usage restrictions (color/placement/partner guidelines), and any clause language you want added to the MSA/order form?

If easier, happy to schedule a 30-min call between legal teams — proposed slots: Mon 3/13 10–11am PT or Tue 3/14 2–3pm PT.

Attachments: MSA_redline_excerpt.pdf (PDF) | OrderForm_ForgeSys_20280311.docx (DOCX) | press_guidelines_draft.md (MD)

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
--
Jasmine Liu | jasmine@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@forgesys-legal.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Elena Ortiz <elena@forgesys.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@forgesys.com>
Date: 2028-03-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ForgeSys customer story & logo use — confidentiality + embargo

On 2028-03-11T09:18:00-07:00, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elena / Sam,
> 
> Thanks again for the great demo last week — the pilot data looks very promising...

Thanks for the clear summary, Jasmine. Please see ForgeSys' high-level position and requested edits below (we're returning the MSA excerpt with tracked changes; I'll send formal redlines through DocuSign if you prefer).

Key requests from ForgeSys legal: 
- Case study attribution: by default we require anonymized metrics/quotes unless ForgeSys signs an explicit release authorizing a named endorsement. We can provide an approved quote but that will require sign-off by our CMO and may take up to 2 weeks.
- Logo use: limited to "press and customer page"; no use in paid advertising or co-branded sales materials without a separate license. Usage must adhere to our brand guidelines (colors, clearspace) — see attached brand_rules.pdf (referenced).
- Embargo: ForgeSys asks for announcement no earlier than 60 days after GA, but we can consider 30 days if Redwood supplies a draft in advance and we confirm copy within 5 business days.
- Confidentiality carveout language: we will accept a narrow publicity carveout for press announcements and case studies that do not disclose confidential implementation details or sensitive metrics. We propose the following addition to the publicity clause: 

  "Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Customer may pre-approve any press release, public case study or customer logo use. Provider will submit drafts to Customer and will await written approval, which shall not be unreasonably withheld; Customer's approval may be subject to redaction of confidential technical details or specific usage metrics."

- We also request an audit trail of any public quotes and a point of contact for approvals (please provide a name and email).

If Redwood is comfortable with anonymized quotes as the default and with the 60/30-day compromise on embargo, we think we can move quickly. Please confirm and share a time for a short legal sync (Alyssa is available Wed 3/15 9–10am PT).

Regards,
Alyssa Chen
Senior Counsel, Corporate
ForgeSys
--
Alyssa Chen | alyssa@forgesys-legal.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-11T13:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ForgeSys customer story & logo use — confidentiality + embargo

Jasmine — thanks for looping us in. Quick internal notes / recommended positions before we reply to Alyssa: 

- Anonymized quote as default is acceptable for now, but push for an option: offer a ready-made, non-technical quote they can approve quickly (reduces friction).
- Logo: agree to brand guidelines + no paid ads clause, but request a 1-year term for display on our customer page with automatic renewal unless they request removal.
- Embargo: counter-propose 30 days after GA as Redwood's preferred term. If they insist on 60, offer a compromise: 45 days or 30 days with a 5-business-day review commitment from ForgeSys on draft copy.
- MSA language: accept their pre-approval requirement but limit the scope — we should attempt to restrict approvals to a single signer and require "not unreasonably withheld" language. Draft language below we can propose: 

  "Customer may review and approve Provider's press release or case study drafts within five (5) business days; approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. In the absence of response within five (5) business days, approval will be deemed granted. Customer may require redaction of Confidential Information as provided in Section X."

- Next step: propose we send a concise reply accepting anonymized quotes by default, offering a sample quote, proposing the 30-day embargo with a 5-business-day review window, and asking for a named approver and a one-year display term for logos.

I'll be on the 3/15 legal call if scheduled.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@forgesys.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@forgesys-legal.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-12T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ForgeSys customer story & logo use — confidentiality + embargo

Elena / Alyssa — thanks for the quick reply and the proposed language. Summary of where Redwood stands after internal review (see attached marked-up MSA excerpt):

Agreed points:
- Default to anonymized quotes unless ForgeSys signs an explicit release — Redwood will provide an optional, short non-technical quote for approval to speed sign-off.
- Redwood will follow ForgeSys' brand guidelines and will not use the logo in paid advertising without separate permission.

Proposals / asks from Redwood:
- Embargo: we prefer 30 days after GA with a 5-business-day approval window for drafts. If ForgeSys requires 60 days, Redwood requests the alternative of 45 days or 30 days with guaranteed 5-business-day review.
- Logo display term on customer page: 1 year with automatic renewal unless ForgeSys requests removal in writing.
- Approval workflow: please provide a single approver name and email (we'll treat that person as the contact for all press approvals).

Next steps: 
1) Alyssa/Elena — please confirm which embargo option you prefer and provide the approver name/email.
2) If acceptable, Alyssa can send back a short tracked redline for the publicity clause and we'll finalize on the legal call (proposed Wed 3/15 9–10am PT).
3) We'll finalize marketing collateral after legal sign-off; Redwood will deliver a draft release and one-page case study for review.

Attached: MSA_redline_excerpt.pdf (PDF) with our suggested language; press_guidelines_draft.md.

Thanks again — happy to hop on the call if helpful.

Best,
Jasmine
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MSA_redline_excerpt.pdf (PDF) | press_guidelines_draft.md (MD)
